name: bash-cli
title: Bash CLI
blurb: Bash CLI: byte counting with no external tools, a hand-rolled argv parser, four swappable I/O functions, assertion suite with no framework

verify.name: usage-error
verify.cmd: set +e; ./bin/{{ npm_name }} --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -eq 2

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd: set +e; ./bin/{{ npm_name }} nope.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -eq 1

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd:
set +e; implicit=$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w); a=$?; explicit=$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w -); b=$?; echo "exit status: $a $b"; test "$a" -eq 0; test "$b" -eq 0; test "$implicit" = '3'; test "$explicit" = '3 -'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd:
set -eu; mkdir -p .parity; printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' > .parity/p1.txt; printf 'alpha
beta
gamma' > .parity/p2.txt; printf 'h\303\251llo w\303\266rld
' > .parity/p3.txt; : > .parity/p4.txt; printf 'a	b\vc d e
' > .parity/p5.txt; for sample in .parity/p1.txt .parity/p2.txt .parity/p3.txt .parity/p4.txt .parity/p5.txt; do ours=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} "$sample"); theirs=$(wc -l -w -c "$sample"); test "$ours" = "$theirs"; done; echo 'parity ok'
